name: _event_msg
strings: % was turned to stone by the witch.
% started the journey in his home village of Tambry
as had his brother before him.
as had his brothers before him.
% just couldn't stay awake any longer!
Even % would not be stupid enough to draw weapon in here.
A great calming influence comes over %, preventing him from drawing his weapon.
% picked up a scrap of paper.
It read: "Meet me at midnight at the Crypt. Signed, the Wraith Lord."
% bought some food and ate it.
% was tired, so he decided to lie down and sleep.
Ground is too hot for swan to land.
% put an apple away for later.
